decision: The two generic bound armor entries deliberately cover both reward choices. Make the choice explicit; do not choose a single inventory/market ID or assign stats for one version to the entire family.

primarySources.scope: Both named armor families have Damage Reduction and Evasion versions; this does not establish exchange eligibility for bound rewards.
Black Spirit Support offers unmarketable armor and a Select 1 reward for gloves/shoes.
Current quest rename/objective mapping and 300 AP requirement, already implemented and retained.

currentCorroboration: Two exact current item IDs for each unmarketable family. Both retain the same nonenhanced Heating-to-1500-Cron restriction; no variant defense/evasion values are projected or calculated by these reference entries.
preserved: Existing source/quest/Family restrictions, no market queries or saved-ID migration. No claim that the general tradable-armor exchange applies to bound rewards. No new selection UI or invented stats.
